basic_profile.bio: I'm a digital marketing consultant based in Richmond, Virginia, passionate about helping small businesses establish their online presence. I spend my free time exploring nature trails and trying out new recipes. I dislike misinformation and overly aggressive online debates. I'm usually online during the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently, I'm single and enjoy engaging with online communities about personal finance and entrepreneurship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing and over a decade of experience in digital marketing strategies. I've honed my skills through various online courses and hands-on projects, especially with platforms like Squarespace.
